units.source_text: 天色已近黎明，晨鸡尚未叫出；

en.t: The sky was already nearing dawn, though the morning rooster had not yet begun to crow;

units.source_text: 但闻几个山僧之类的老人诵经礼拜之声，

en.t: only the voices of several old men, like mountain monks, could be heard chanting sutras and bowing in worship,

units.source_text: 他们是在为朝山进香预先修行[\[15\]](#part1333.html#m15)。

en.t: for they were performing preliminary austerities before making a pilgrimage to the mountain and offering incense[\[15\]](#part1333.html#m15).

units.source_text: 想他们跪拜起伏，定多辛苦，觉得很可怜。

en.t: Thinking how hard it must be for them to kneel, bow, rise, and prostrate themselves again, he felt great pity for them.

units.source_text: 源氏公子心中自问：“人世无常，有如朝露；何苦贪婪地为己身祈祷呢？”

en.t: Prince Genji asked himself inwardly, "Human life is impermanent, like morning dew; why cling so greedily and pray for one's own body?"

units.source_text: 正在想时，听见念着“南无当来导师弥勒菩萨”而跪拜之声[\[16\]](#part1333.html#m16)。

en.t: As he was thinking this, he heard voices bowing in worship while chanting, "Homage to Maitreya Bodhisattva, the future teacher"[\[16\]](#part1333.html#m16).

units.source_text: 公子深为感动，对夕颜说：“你听！

en.t: Deeply moved, the prince said to Yugao, "Listen!

units.source_text: 这些老人也不仅为此生，又为来生修行呢！”

en.t: These old men are practicing not only for this life, but also for the life to come!"
